[F003] The 5 reachable failures are identical with my `cli.py` reverted — they're pre-existing/environmental (the working tree is dirty with modified plan files, so e.g. `test_plan_status_pre_impl_sync_f002` hits `PAUSED on plan drift … audit/gate-state.json`). My changes are restored. The 6th failure (`test_case_d_cli_main_returns_nonzero_on_invalid_target_context`) is in the same pre-existing module. My F003 changes added no new failures: the parity, agent-surface, and what-now suites are fully green (97/97), and the full sweep went from these same 6 pre-existing failures with and without my edits.

Let me record the commands I ran for the audit trail.

$ python -m pytest dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_renderer_parity_f003.py dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_f002_agent_surface_cli.py dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_operations_guidance_f007.py -q
$ python -m pytest dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/ -q
$ git stash push -- scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py
$ python -m pytest <5 failing tests> -q
$ git stash pop

All three findings are addressed.
